senses.gloss: m. (טבע, v. טַבַּעַת) ring, hook, clasp.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 32a:3">Men. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דסיפרי</he> clasp for fastening the leaves of books while reading.—Pl. (<he>אַטְבְּעֵי</he>) <cite ref="I00063"><he>אַטְבֵּי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 98a:5">Sabb. 98ᵃ</cite> Ar. <he>אטבי</he> (ed. <he>באטבעי אטבעי</he>, some ed. <he>בא׳ בטבעי</he>, corr. acc., Ms. M. only <he>בטבעי</he>, margin <he>אטבי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6">Num. R. s. 6</cite> (in Hebr. diction) <he>א׳ של ברזל</he> iron clasps (to fasten the boards on the wagon).
